notes: The Varys panel now lists the page's broken links: what each one says, where it pointed, what happened and since when. Show me finds a link in the body; Remove link unlinks it and keeps the words, with Undo until you change the body. Nothing saves until you press Save. Links that come from a listing, a sidebar block or the menu say so: ask the web team. If you installed it by hand: after replacing the folder, press the reload arrow on the extension's card in chrome://extensions, or the update does not take effect.
